fields.label: Enable Activity Tracking
fields.description: Master switch. When off, no activity logs are written regardless of mappings.

fields.label: Track Only During WFH Sessions
fields.description: If enabled, activities are only logged when the employee has an open WFH Session today.

fields.label: Default Daily Points Cap
fields.description: Used for any mapping that has no cap set in Activity Configuration.

fields.label: Inactivity Flag Threshold (hours)
fields.description: Sessions with no activity for this many hours get flagged automatically.

fields.label: DocType → Event Mappings
fields.description: Add each DocType you want to track. The engine will hook into the selected events at runtime — no bench restart required.

fields.label: Help
fields.options:
1. Add a row for each DocType you want to monitor.
2. Tick the events to capture (Submit, Update, Cancel, Create).
3. The engine reads this table at runtime — changes take effect immediately.
4. Scoring rules (points, dampening, caps) are configured in Activity Configuration — one record per DocType.
5. If no Activity Configuration exists for a DocType, the engine uses base defaults.
